'''Clars''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nilya Fek'ra]] as a doorman. He wore elegant clothing, and carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with ear receiver and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TSB" />
